Comment: Lyft NYCTLC Data Pipeline - Orchestrated by Step Functions

StartIngestionJob.Comment: Step 1/3 - Run the Python Shell Glue job that ingests NYCTLC data.

StartRawToCuratedJob.Comment: Step 2/3 - Run the Spark Glue job that transforms raw to curated.

StartCuratedToAggregatedJob.Comment: Step 3/3 - Run the Spark Glue job that aggregates curated data.

NotifyIngestionFailure.Comment: Publish the step 1 failure details directly to the pipeline alerts SNS topic (step name embedded in the message).

Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Lyft NYCTLC Data Pipeline FAILED at step StartIngestionJob (Glue job: mission-deh-hof-nyctlc-ingestion). Error: {}. Cause: {}', $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)

NotifyRawToCuratedFailure.Comment: Publish the step 2 failure details directly to the pipeline alerts SNS topic (step name embedded in the message).

Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Lyft NYCTLC Data Pipeline FAILED at step StartRawToCuratedJob (Glue job: mission-deh-hof-raw-to-curated-etl). Error: {}. Cause: {}', $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)

NotifyCuratedToAggregatedFailure.Comment: Publish the step 3 failure details directly to the pipeline alerts SNS topic (step name embedded in the message).

Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Lyft NYCTLC Data Pipeline FAILED at step StartCuratedToAggregatedJob (Glue job: mission-deh-hof-curated-to-aggregated-etl). Error: {}. Cause: {}', $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)

PipelineFailed.Cause: One or more Glue jobs failed. An SNS notification with the failing step and error details has been published.

NotifyPipelineSuccess.Comment: Publish the pipeline success notification to the pipeline alerts SNS topic.

Parameters.Message: Lyft NYCTLC Data Pipeline SUCCEEDED - All 3 Glue jobs completed: mission-deh-hof-nyctlc-ingestion, mission-deh-hof-raw-to-curated-etl, mission-deh-hof-curated-to-aggregated-etl.
